description: Saavi main window: open/save dialogs (the chosen paths are scoped by the dialog itself), text + binary file read/write for backups and sealed files, opening the download page in the browser, and the one-click updater (download is signature-verified against the key baked into this binary; install happens only on the user's click). The Rust-side http client is scoped to exactly what the app needs — WKD paths on any domain, keys.openpgp.org, the Kaditham WKD publish endpoint, and the update manifest + release assets — so compromised frontend code gets no arbitrary-host exfiltration channel.
